calls.statement:
SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date_utc,
  COUNT(*) AS web_order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)

SELECT 
  CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) AS order_date_utc,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS distinct_orders,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) AS null_timestamps
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) BETWEEN '2025-11-27' AND '2025-11-29'
GROUP BY CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE)
ORDER BY order_date_utc

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY order_count DESC
